metadata.datasource: Historical instax mini data sheet, p.3; 5500 K, 1/100 s, 25 C, read at 24 h
metadata.license: CC0-1.0 (new numerical chart readings; source documents retain their copyright)
limitations: Historical effective reflection-density prototype; not current film or chemical diffusion simulation. Spectral cross-talk/base are approximate.
历史材料有效反射密度验证，并非现售配方或药剂扩散模拟；染料串扰／纸白近似。
metadata.reading_precision: approx. 0.05 density, 5-10 nm and 0.1 log sensitivity; not instrument measurements
metadata.tails: constant endpoints outside chart range; not measured latitude
metadata.grain: equal thirds sublayer decomposition is assumed; no stock-specific spatial grain calibration
metadata.density_demixing: ASSUMED narrow-band 640/550/440 nm densitometer; H-D densities demixed into nonnegative dye concentrations, avoiding double-counted spectral overlap. Not a measured Status A instrument fit.
